# artie_snowflake_eco_schedule (Resource)

Artie Snowflake Eco Mode schedule resource. A schedule sets a pipeline's peak hours; outside them (including all of any day not in `peak_days`), pipelines attached with `snowflake_eco_schedule_uuid` on `artie_pipeline` use the off-peak flush rules to save Snowflake credits.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "artie_snowflake_eco_schedule" "business_hours" {
  name            = "Business hours"
  timezone        = "America/New_York"
  peak_days       = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday"]
  peak_start_time = "09:00"
  peak_end_time   = "18:00"

  # Outside peak hours (weeknights and all weekend), flush every 30 minutes.
  off_peak_flush_interval_seconds = 1800
  off_peak_buffer_rows            = 500000
  off_peak_flush_size_kb          = 250000
}

resource "artie_pipeline" "my_pipeline" {
  # ...
  snowflake_eco_schedule_uuid = artie_snowflake_eco_schedule.business_hours.uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A human-readable label for this schedule.
- `off_peak_buffer_rows` (Number) How many rows pipelines buffer before flushing outside peak hours.
- `off_peak_flush_interval_seconds` (Number) How often, in seconds, pipelines flush outside peak hours (at least 10).
- `off_peak_flush_size_kb` (Number) How much data, in KB, pipelines buffer before flushing outside peak hours.
- `peak_days` (Set of String) The days that have peak hours: `Sunday`, `Monday`, `Tuesday`, `Wednesday`, `Thursday`, `Friday` or `Saturday`. Any other day is off-peak all day.
- `peak_end_time` (String) When peak hours end on each of `peak_days`, as 24-hour `HH:MM`, like `18:00`. Must be later than `peak_start_time`; peak hours can't cross midnight.
- `peak_start_time` (String) When peak hours start on each of `peak_days`, as 24-hour `HH:MM`, like `09:00`.
- `timezone` (String) The IANA time zone of the peak hours, like `America/New_York`.

### Read-Only

- `uuid` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a Snowflake Eco Mode schedule by its UUID. List your schedules' UUIDs with
# GET https://api.artie.com/snowflake-eco-schedules, or read snowflake_eco_schedule_uuid
# from an artie_pipeline that uses the schedule.
terraform import artie_snowflake_eco_schedule.my_schedule <snowflake_eco_schedule_uuid>

# Then print the state and copy it into your terraform config file
# (be sure to remove all read-only fields, like `uuid`):
terraform state show artie_snowflake_eco_schedule.my_schedule
```
